test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**their**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The pronoun must agree with the noun **“individuals”**, which is plural.
 
• Out of all the options, only **"their"** correctly refers back to “individuals” in a gender-neutral and plural form.
 
• “His” and “her” are singular and gender-specific, which do not fit the context of addressing multiple people.
 
• “You” is second person, which is inappropriate as the sentence discusses third-person individuals.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage (so far): *It **makes__** no discriminations to nationality, race, religious beliefs, class or political opinions. It endeavours to **__relieve__** the suffering of individuals, being guided solely by **__their__** needs...*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Their :** Plural possessive pronoun correctly matching “individuals”.
 
• **His/Her:** Singular and gendered, unsuitable for plural “individuals”.
 
• **You:** Second person pronoun
